title: Intellectual Property Documentation Database — Overview and definition
body: Public edition. Sourced public knowledge, fact-checked reference; never mixed with Signature records. Invention notes, authorship records, dated versions, and disclosure tracking. The Intellectual Property Documentation Database is the inventor's notebook, systematized: dated invention notes, who contributed what (authorship records), version histories of the idea as it evolved, and disclosure tracking (who was told what, when, under what terms). Priority disputes are won by documentation — each record is organized so that inventorship, dates, and disclosures are provable, with the chain of custody intact from first sketch to filing.

title: Intellectual Property Documentation Database — Knowledge: technical reference
body: Public edition. Sourced public knowledge, fact-checked reference; never mixed with Signature records. Documentation anatomy: INVENTION NOTES (date, author, content, witness/countersignature; bound or hash-chained digital — no backdating possible); AUTHORSHIP (who conceived what — conception, not effort, determines inventorship; contribution log per person); VERSIONS (dated evolution of the idea; what changed and why); DISCLOSURES (every external sharing: who, when, what, NDA yes/no — public disclosure starts clocks in many jurisdictions); FILING READINESS (problem, solution, embodiments, alternatives, prior art awareness, drawings). Rules: record contemporaneously (same day); never rewrite history (corrections as new entries); keep the chain unbroken. Jurisdiction notes: US first-to-file (post-AIA); grace periods vary; foreign filing licenses where required.

demo.code: const opts={A:{perf:9,rel:6,simple:5},B:{perf:6,rel:9,simple:8}};const w={perf:0.5,rel:0.3,simple:0.2};function score(o){return o.perf*w.perf+o.rel*w.rel+o.simple*w.simple;}const sA=score(opts.A),sB=score(opts.B);const w2={perf:0.3,rel:0.5,simple:0.2};function score2(o){return o.perf*w2.perf+o.rel*w2.rel+o.simple*w2.simple;}const flip=score2(opts.B)>score2(opts.A);J({sA:+sA.toFixed(2),sB:+sB.toFixed(2),flip});assert(sA>sB&&flip,'tradeoff');
